additional_info.subject: ID0447221-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2/PN 312571675/07] Error: ChargerOperationMode CRM:02889000560
additional_info.body:
Hi,
On September 4th, I noticed that the charging station was working again. I was waiting for feedback from your side to understand what had happened. During my visit to the site on the 4th, the station was fully operational.
However, I’m now seeing that the station is once again showing the error code "ChargerOperationMode" in our supervision system. Today, the SCB router is properly connected and allows us to view the error flags. I believe the station is in "Fail Safe Mode". Can you confirm this?
When do you plan to intervene?
Thank you in advance.
Cordialement,
